scope: Full image encode, tokenization, denoising and VAE decode; excludes loading, JIT, offline weight packing, safety checker and video file encoding
quantization: Generator FFNs only: current model RTN W4, identity prescale, full ACT2, no W1 repair; no Nano calibration transfer
attention: Joint variants use generation-only 75% dual-first-order repair, uniform heads; causal understanding attention stays SDPA
prompt: A stationary camera observes a robot arm in a workspace. The robot arm moves slowly and smoothly toward an object on the table. The background, lighting, and camera position remain unchanged. Objects keep their shape and position except for the deliberate motion of the arm.
negative_prompt: distorted objects, flickering, abrupt camera motion, blurry, low quality
